title: Ectopic Pregnancy
sources: Critical Vector — OB Pocket Guide: Ectopic Pregnancy (ACOG 2023)
ACOG Practice Bulletin 193, Tubal Ectopic Pregnancy

changelog.change: Initial entry — β-hCG / discriminatory-zone interpretation, single-dose methotrexate eligibility + monitoring, surgical indications, ruptured-ectopic protocol.

summary: Any β-hCG-positive patient with no intrauterine pregnancy on transvaginal ultrasound has an ectopic until proven otherwise. A ruptured ectopic is an immediate surgical emergency — do not delay theatre for further imaging or a methotrexate workup.

rows: β-hCG 1500–3000 mIU/mL — a normal IUP should be visible on TVUS at this level
Serial β-hCG q48h. Normal IUP rises ≥ 53–66% in 48 h; ectopic plateaus or rises < 53%
Likely a completed miscarriage — can observe if the patient is stable
RhoGAM 300 mcg IM regardless of the β-hCG level

body.text: A β-hCG above the discriminatory zone with an empty uterus is highly suspicious for ectopic — but a single value below it does not exclude one. Use the trend and the ultrasound together, and involve OB early for a pregnancy of unknown location.

items: Normal CBC, hepatic and renal function.
No intrauterine pregnancy confirmed on TVUS.
No fetal cardiac activity in the ectopic sac.
Ectopic mass ≤ 3.5 cm (relative; some use ≤ 4 cm).
β-hCG ≤ 5000 mIU/mL (relative contraindication above this — higher failure rate).
Reliable for follow-up and understands the warning symptoms.

rows: β-hCG on days 4 and 7 post-dose; expect a ≥ 15% fall between days 4 and 7
Repeat methotrexate (2nd dose); consider surgery if a 3rd dose would be needed
Folic acid / prenatal vitamins, NSAIDs, alcohol, sun exposure, intercourse, gas-forming foods

items: Indications: haemodynamic instability; methotrexate contraindicated; methotrexate failure; fetal cardiac activity; patient preference.
Salpingectomy is preferred if the contralateral tube is normal; salpingostomy if it is the only remaining tube.
Laparoscopy is preferred when stable; laparotomy if unstable or with a large haemoperitoneum.

body.text: Ruptured ectopic is immediately life-threatening. There is no time for a methotrexate workup — activate theatre now.

items: Two large-bore IVs; type and crossmatch; activate massive transfusion if needed.
Fluid resuscitation; permissive hypotension until surgical control.
Emergent surgical consult — do NOT delay for additional imaging.
Laparoscopy if stable, laparotomy if unstable or large hemoperitoneum.
